findings.summary: wiki_ingest_apply performs zero validation: it assigns ids and writes pages directly without calling validate_page, checking title uniqueness, provenance, or outlinks. Spec §3 requires apply to '逐页走与 wiki_create 同一套校验代码路径（不得复制第二份校验实现）' and §4 requires ingest-grade validation. This breaks INV-1 (single-gate write) and allows duplicate-title overwrites violating INV-2.

EmbeddingClient.embed silently swallows all exceptions via 'except Exception: return None', discarding the error text entirely. Spec §9 explicitly prohibits silent exception swallowing ('v1 向量索引静默死 15 天的直接根因'). Because embed returns None instead of raising, _embed_page's degradation handler (search.py:215-217) is never triggered, so embedding failures leave pages un-vectorized but NOT marked degraded and with last_error unset — the exact silent vector-index-death failure mode INV-4 was designed to make visible.

validate_edit_grade has inverted missing-field logic: it errors when a field was missing before AND remains missing after ('操作前已缺失，操作后仍缺失'), but the spec §4 says '缺失字段可保持缺失' (missing fields may stay missing). Conversely it never checks the case the spec actually prohibits — a field present before but removed after ('不得新增缺失'). This falsely blocks edits to migrated/legacy pages with missing fields and fails to catch real violations.

check_frontmatter does not require source_type and credibility for 卡片/索引 page types at ingest-grade. The spec §2 frontmatter table marks both as 'create 时必填' and §4 states ingest-grade requires '§2 表全部必填'. The code only enforces these fields for CODE_TYPES (源码分析/架构); for 卡片/索引 both may be absent with no error.

The 'katana-wiki-v2-mcp --rebuild-index' CLI command required by spec §6 is missing. server.main() takes no arguments and unconditionally starts the HTTP server; there is no argparse or subcommand handling. The rebuild_index() method exists on WikiStore but is not exposed through the console script, so index rebuild cannot be invoked from the command line.

Migration never writes migration-conflicts.json to <dest> as spec §7 requires ('全部收进 <dest>/migration-conflicts.json 报告'). On conflict the code only prints to stdout (and only in the dry_run branch) and returns the report in the dict; the conflict_path variable is computed but never written. The non-dry-run conflict path produces no output at all.

wiki_rename skips rewriting the renamed page's own body for [[old_title]] self-references (the loop continues when other_page id matches the renamed page). If a page references itself by its old title, the link becomes broken after rename, violating INV-3 ('rename 完成后库内不存在由该操作新增的 broken wikilink').

wiki_list computes the cursor start index by scanning the unfiltered all_pages list but then applies that index to the prefix-filtered items list, misaligning pagination whenever prefix and cursor are used together.
